SEC-1 [] CSRF protection rests on SameSite=Lax alone; no antiforgery token is issued or checked. ISolated state-changing GET endpoints (db/backups/open-folder) became reachable cross-site under the new cookie scheme. Recommend SameSite=Strict for the auth cookie and/or server-side antiforgery validation, and move actions that mutate host state off GET.

SEC-2 [] Availability: IP-partitioned rate limits (including the R10 reset limiter) are not forwarded-header aware, so behind the reverse proxy common in a cloud deployment they degrade to a shared site-wide budget that one attacker can starve. Configure trusted-proxy forwarding (X-Forwarded-For) or partition on a subnet/account basis instead.

SEC-3 [] The session cookie is only marked Secure when the app itself observes an HTTPS request. In a TLS-terminating-proxy deployment without forwarded-headers configuration the cookie is transmitted in the clear over the local hop. Enforce Secure for the auth cookie in cloud mode (or set ForwardedHeaders/KnownProxies) before production.
